findings.title: Migration SQL injection via embeddable host value
findings.body: The migration interpolates raw site-setting values directly into SQL: execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)". A stored host containing a single quote breaks the statement or allows SQL injection. An admin-controlled setting should never be string-interpolated into SQL; use quoting/sanitization or ActiveRecord creates.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting is missing/blank
findings.body: The migration does execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name='embed_category'")[0]['id']. If the setting row is missing, blank, or does not match a category name, [0] is nil and ['id'] raises, aborting the migration for all installs. It must handle zero rows and fall back to uncategorized_category_id.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: app/models/embeddable_host.rb calls self.host.sub! twice without a nil guard. Creating/updating an EmbeddableHost with a missing host raises NoMethodError instead of a validation error, turning a 422 into a 500.

findings.title: Case-insensitive host lookup is broken
findings.body: app/models/embeddable_host.rb queries where("lower(host) = ?", host) without downcasing the argument. A host stored lowercase will not match a mixed/upper-case referer URL host, so EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? incorrectly rejects allowed hosts and embedding/retrieval fails.

findings.title: update/destroy dereference nil when host not found
findings.body: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb looks up the host with where(id: params[:id]).first and then calls save_host(host) or host.destroy without a nil check. An unknown id raises NoMethodError (500) instead of 404, and save_host will also crash on nil.

findings.title: No uniqueness constraint on embeddable host
findings.body: EmbeddableHost validates format but has no validates_uniqueness_of nor unique DB index on host. Admins can create duplicate host rows, making host_allowed?/category mapping ambiguous and allowing divergent categories for the same host.

findings.title: Plural embedded ids assume non-null array
findings.body: In _hydrateEmbedded the plural branch calls obj[k].map without checking for null/non-array. If a payload has color_ids: null or a singular value, the client throws TypeError and hydration fails. It should guard and filter missing lookups.
